header: Deterministic employee analytics. My rule: every number comes from the DB via parameterized SQL, never from AI. Stage 8 overhaul (28 Sep 2026): I rebuilt the people layer below entirely on `employee_roster`/`designation_grade`/`sail_department` (rosterQuery.ts / designationGrades.ts / sailDepartments.ts). The old queryPeople()/countByTerm()/etc that queried public."user" directly and sorted by parsed ticket number are gone. Every list here is `ORDER BY global_seniority_rank`, no exceptions. The holiday section below (Stage 2) is untouched and unaffected by this.

members.name: pendingPatternId
doc: Added 29 Sep 2026 for the feedback loop of my hybrid LLM router (see queryOrchestrator.ts / patternCache.ts). It is present ONLY when this answer came from a fresh LLM classification that generalized to a new, not-yet-trusted pattern. The frontend should show a tick/cross on any payload carrying this id, and call the pattern-feedback endpoint with it on an explicit click. I infer nothing from behaviour: no click, no signal. It is absent for every other answer (deterministic parser, or an already-confirmed cache hit), and those never need feedback UI at all.

members.name: interpretation
doc: Added 29 Sep 2026: a plain-language statement of how an LLM-derived query was understood (e.g. `Name has the word "kumar" and "kumar" is not the first word ...`). Present only on answers that came from the LLM tier or a learned-pattern hit, never on deterministic-parser answers. The verifier proves the rows match the interpreted condition; this line lets the person check that the condition itself matches what they meant.

doc: The original public entry point: it parses a raw query with the deterministic regex/pattern parser, then executes it. I kept it exactly as before for any existing caller. It is now also the FALLBACK path that the new LLM orchestrator (queryOrchestrator.ts) calls when LLM classification fails or declines to handle a query.

symbols.name: HOLIDAY_TYPE_LABELS
symbols.sig: const HOLIDAY_TYPE_LABELS = HOLIDAY_TYPE_LABEL as unknown as Record<string, string>
doc: Execute an already-parsed intent and produce the final display payload. I split this out of answerAnalytics() on 29 Sep 2026 so that the new LLM-based intent orchestrator (queryOrchestrator.ts) can supply its OWN grounded intent directly, without going through the regex/pattern parser at all. That parser (parseAnalytics, below) is now the FALLBACK path only, used when the LLM classification fails or is low-confidence. Every existing intent kind and its formatting is unchanged.

The return type stays NULLABLE (not a plain AnalyticsPayload) on purpose: a weak, unquoted peopleByName search that finds nothing returns null, which means "let the caller fall through to semantic/circular search" rather than assert "no employees found". Do not paper this over into a forced non-null return; it has to survive the split.
